name: Setting group
summary: The settings GROUP container — an optional semibold header (with a "?" help and an action slot) over a column of rows — that bakes in the panel spacing scale so gaps come out right automatically.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-setting-group> — that encodes the settings-panel SPACING scale so you never hand-place a gap. Rows inside a group sit 16px apart (the between-settings step); stacked groups sit 32px apart automatically (`:host(:not(:first-child))` — no wiring); a danger-zone group (`tone="danger"`) drops 48px (overriding the 32). An optional `label` renders a semibold (600) header with an optional `?` help trigger — the composed DS <aha-tooltip help>, never a hand-placed icon — and an `action` slot pushed to the right. NO divider line, NO card/tinted box — spacing only, white background. role="group" + aria-label so AT announces it. Header + rows are persistent nodes. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens → byte-identical in React and Vue. Zero drift.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

props.name: label
props.desc: Optional group header (a 1–3 word noun phrase). When set, renders a semibold header and becomes the group's aria-label

props.name: help
props.desc: Optional guidance shown as the "?" help tooltip (composed DS <aha-tooltip help>) after the header label — never a standing line

props.name: tone
props.desc: danger → a danger-zone group, dropped 48px below the previous group (overrides the automatic 32). Spacing only — the danger CTA styling lives on the button

props.name: action
props.desc: Forwarded to the header, right-aligned — e.g. a small link or button beside the group title

props.name: (default slot)
props.desc: The setting rows / sub-groups; they stack 16px apart automatically

whenToUse.when: a titled cluster of related settings in a panel — it bakes in the 16/32/48 spacing scale
dependent child settings that appear under one parent toggle (indent + tight gap)
you want the whole surface rendered from a schema (rows + reused DS controls) in one element

opinion.note: Reach for a group whenever you place more than one setting in a panel — it removes the temptation to eyeball gaps or draw a divider. Title it with a noun phrase; put guidance in the "?" help, not a standing line. Never wrap plain settings in a card or separate them with a line — hierarchy is spacing. Reserve tone="danger" for a genuine danger zone (delete / reset), and put the destructive styling on the CTA button inside it.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. The probe is a group with a header + 2 rows, followed by a second group (data-next-probe) so the automatic 32px between-group margin is measurable. Measures ≥4 props incl a colour (header label) + px (rows gap, between-group margin).
